title: LEDGER
description: One aligned ledger of the work on a vermilion ground, with a live miniature in every row. Find, enlarge and read in place.
signature: A ruler posts the 28 entries top to bottom while the total counts up; each miniature starts when its row lands. One clock drives 28 crisp, device-pixel canvases and pauses hidden cells. A focus bar takes the colour of the row it glides to, a cell grows 3× while it runs, and each case opens in its row.
holdback: Only 9 of 28 rows show real work; one size and one face keep the hierarchy flat on purpose.
